title: Ridgeguard (Tori): modeled ₹298/qtl left, Naraingarh → Ganaur
summary: June 2025: reported ridgeguard (Tori) prices at Naraingarh and Ganaur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 88% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹298 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 14 same-variety market pairs screened for ridgeguard (Tori) in June 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Ganaur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: June 2025
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Ganaur (Haryana) both reported ridgeguard (Tori) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹1,000 per quintal. Ganaur reported a median ₹1,400 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹400/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹400 per quintal, and Ganaur was dearer on 92% of days.

scenes.headline: 172 km by road
scenes.caption: 172 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹37/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹252 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹165 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Ganaur report, the rule selects 19 of 25 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹298 per quintal (₹213 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Ridgeguard (Tori) route from Naraingarh to Ganaur was positive on 88% of matched days in June 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹29,800, or ₹21,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to ridgeguard (Tori)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹37/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Ridgeguard (Tori) route from Naraingarh to Ganaur was positive on 88% of matched days in June 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹29,800, or ₹21,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
